channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Open-Source Project Brings Full iOS 27 Virtualization to Apple Silicon
item.description: The open-Source project vphone-cli enables a full iOS 27 system to run as a virtual machine on Apple Silicon. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The gpg.fail aftermath: On responsible disclosure, GPG, and the state of security in 2026 [32:37]
item.description: slides In 2025, I [the speaker] found and disclosed a bunch of vulnerabilities in GPG, the most used PGP implementation, and held a talk at 39c3 about it. Some of the bugs ended up getting fixed. (1 source: lobsters)
